script_text: Something big is shifting in your chart this week, and most Taurus won't see it coming. Early week, Venus in your 1st House sextiles Jupiter in your 10th on Tuesday, opening a career door you've been chasing. But Wednesday Mars squares transiting Uranus in your 5th, sparking sudden romantic chaos. Mid-week, Venus sextiles Mars on Thursday, giving you rare courage in love. Thursday through Sunday, the Sun enters your 2nd House, tightening your financial grip. Saturday the Moon squares Saturn in your 7th, making a partner conversation feel heavy. Best day is Wednesday, Venus in your 1st House puts you in peak power. Worst day is Saturday, the Moon-Saturn square creates real partnership tension. This week, pause before replying to that heated text. Follow for daily updates.
